verdict.rationale: Greptile ships an official CLI: `greptile review` reviews the feature-branch diff, and the docs show API-key authentication for CI. The machine-readable part is weak: `--agent` only outputs "raw text" for an agent to consume, and no structured format such as JSON or SARIF is documented. Missing for 10: documented structured output (JSON/SARIF/exit codes), explicit uncommitted/local working-tree diff support, independent hands-on corroboration of CLI/CI use.

support.subject: As a developer, I run reviews from a CLI against local diffs or in CI scripts, with machine-readable output my tooling can consume

citations.quote: Run `greptile review`, get a review of the feature branch diff in 60 seconds.
For CI or self-hosted deployments, use an API key: export GREPTILE_API_KEY=... greptile review
`greptile review --agent` outputs every greptile catch as raw text with a suggested fix for your agent to apply.
